summary: Build practical sustainable ICT asset management skills for lifecycle cost, energy, procurement, reuse, and secure disposal. Enrol today.
lede: Sustainable ICT asset management helps educational technology, procurement, and operations professionals make informed decisions about equipment throughout its lifecycle. The course addresses the practical work of creating an asset register, estimating lifecycle costs and energy or carbon impacts, and setting sustainable procurement criteria. Participants also assess device use and condition, plan repair and reuse, and develop secure end-of-use processes for educational technology fleets.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who influence the sustainability, availability, procurement, security, or lifecycle of educational technology and ICT assets. It supports intermediate practitioners who already work with technology, procurement, facilities, sustainability, or institutional operations and need a more integrated asset management approach.
modules: Repair, Reuse, and Circular Technology Flows
prerequisites: You should bring examples of your institution's ICT asset categories, lifecycle policies, procurement criteria, energy records, or disposal procedures where permitted. TrainingCred provides practice datasets, calculation templates, diagnostic checklists, reporting formats, and workshop materials. You do not need to install specialist software or write code.
